name: Eye Reflection Consistency
description: Analyzes catchlight and eye reflection patterns
algorithm: Eye Reflection Consistency — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye reflections (corneal specular highlights) for deepfake detection:

1. **SpecularHighlight检测**: Corneal reflections (Purkinje images) are detected in each eye per frame. These bright spots on the curved corneal surface reflect the ambient light environment — creating miniature images of light sources visible in high-resolution video.

2. **BilateralReflection一致性**: Both eyes of the same person should show consistent specular reflections — same light sources, similar positions adjusted for inter-ocular distance, and consistent highlight shapes. Deepfake generators often produce eyes independently, creating reflection inconsistencies (different number of highlights, different positions, different shapes between left and right eyes).

3. **物理Reflection建模**: Corneal reflections should be physically consistent with the scene illumination: (a) positions determined by light source locations via reflection geometry, (b) shapes following corneal curvature, (c) brightness proportional to light source intensity. The method verifies these physical constraints. AI-generated reflections may violate geometric reflection laws.

4. **时间Reflection跟踪**: As the head moves, corneal reflections should shift smoothly according to the changing viewing angle. The method tracks reflection positions across frames — they should follow smooth trajectories consistent with rigid body motion. Deepfakes may produce reflections that jump erratically or remain stationary during head movement.

5. **Environment一致性Cross-Check**: Corneal reflections provide information about the scene environment. The method cross-checks reflections between both eyes and against visible scene lighting. Inconsistencies between reflected and visible light sources indicate manipulation or generation artifacts.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through eye reflection consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
